sources.content: The brisolt-runner image runs the Brisolt CI job runner, which pulls jobs from a Brisolt server and executes them in isolated workspaces. It is built on ubuntu:24.04 and runs as user runner with user ID 1001. The runner opens an outbound connection to its server, so receiving jobs needs no inbound port. Job workspaces are created under /builds, and the tool cache lives in /opt/brisolt/cache. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/brisolt-runner with the default command start.

BRISOLT_SERVER_URL points the runner at its server and has no default. BRISOLT_TOKEN holds the registration token and must be set. BRISOLT_CONCURRENCY sets how many jobs run at once and defaults to 2. BRISOLT_JOB_TIMEOUT defaults to 3600 seconds. A Prometheus metrics endpoint is served on port 9252 when BRISOLT_METRICS is set to true; it is off by default. The health check runs brisolt-runner status every 20 seconds. Logs are written to standard output in JSON.

claims.text: The brisolt-runner image is built on ubuntu:24.04.
